name: Chemin panorama alpin
description_md:
Chemin panorama alpin is a hard waymarked hiking route in Switzerland that covers a distance of 27.6 km. The route is signposted as 3 and follows the national waymarked hiking network.

The trail includes 264 m of ascent and 348 m of descent, requiring about 7.7 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The geometry matches the official route published by swisstopo. Walkers will find that the route passes Palace of Nations within 200 m, Geneva within 500 m, and ICRC within 600 m.
